landing.eyebrow: Ek dibbe mein poori event team
landing.title: OFFSTAGE ko apne event ke baare mein batao.
landing.subtitle: Yeh team banata hai, show chalata hai, aur tumse sirf tab poochta hai jab zaroori ho.
landing.line1: Kuch lines mein apna event batao. Commander zaroori sawaal poochta hai, phir plan, budget aur agents ki team banata hai.
landing.line2: Har agent event ka ek hissa sambhalta hai aur ek human lead ke saath kaam karta hai, jo logon, paise ya reputation se judi har cheez approve karta hai.
landing.line3: Event ke din agents changes, check-ins aur sawaal sambhalte hain. Emergency seedha insaanon tak jaati hai.
landing.demoNote: HackNova 2026 ek sample tech fest hai, iske log kaalpanik hain.

lawDetail.propose: Har change ek proposal se shuru hota hai, kaaran aur saboot ke saath.
lawDetail.decide: Code mein likhe rules tay karte hain ki kis change ko kitna approval chahiye.
lawDetail.approve: Logon par asar daalne wali har cheez sahi insaan ka intezaar karti hai.
lawDetail.execute: Sirf approved changes chalte hain, aur zyaadatar undo ho sakte hain.

aboutAi.title: Hamare AI ke baare mein
aboutAi.intro: OFFSTAGE events chalane mein AI ki madad leta hai. Yahan simple shabdon mein bataya hai ki yeh kya karta hai, kya kabhi nahi karta, aur tumhare data ka kya hota hai.
aboutAi.decideTitle: AI suggest karta hai, decide insaan karte hain
aboutAi.decideBody: Agents plans, messages aur changes draft karte hain. Logon, paise ya event ki reputation par asar daalne wali har cheez ek tay insaan ke approval ka intezaar karti hai. Chhote internal records apne aap chalte hain, aur unhe 10 minute tak undo kar sakte ho.
aboutAi.tiersTitle: Kis change ko kitna approval chahiye
aboutAi.labelledTitle: Har automated message yeh batata hai
aboutAi.labelledBody: Assistant ke likhe messages mein ek line hoti hai ki kisne draft kiya aur kis role ne approve kiya, jaise:
aboutAi.honestBody: Helpdesk sirf event ke apne documents se jawaab deta hai aur dikhata hai ki har jawaab kahan se aaya. Jab pakka na ho, toh andaaza lagane ke bajaye tumhara sawaal kisi insaan tak pahunchata hai.
aboutAi.emergencyBody: Medical, safety, aag aur harassment ki reports agents ko skip karke turant organisers ko alert karti hain. Agents sirf updates draft karne mein madad karte hain.
aboutAi.dataTitle: Kam se kam data, event ke baad delete
aboutAi.dataBody: Hum sirf wahi lete hain jo event ke liye zaroori hai, aur poochte waqt wajah batate hain. Agar tumne certificate nahi maanga, toh event ke 90 din baad tumhari personal details delete ho jaati hain. Phone number aur email encrypted rehte hain, aur AI tumhari contact details nahi, sirf IDs aur masked details dekhta hai.
aboutAi.rightsBody: Apne attendee portal se tum dekh sakte ho ki humare paas kya hai, uski copy le sakte ho, ya delete karne ke liye bol sakte ho.
aboutAi.limitsBody: OFFSTAGE ko LLM applications ke liye OWASP Top 10 ko dhyaan mein rakhkar banaya gaya hai aur yeh India ke Digital Personal Data Protection Act ke principles ke saath aligned hai. Ise kisi ne certify nahi kiya hai. Yeh English, Hindi aur Hinglish mein kaam karta hai; baaki bhashayein abhi supported nahi hain.

register.title: {event} ke liye register karo
register.intro: Bas do minute lagenge. Hum sirf wahi poochte hain jo event ke liye zaroori hai.
register.name: Poora naam
register.nameHint: Jaisa tumhare certificate par hona chahiye
register.phoneHint: Optional. Sirf reminders aur zaroori changes ke liye.
register.rollNoHint: Optional. Sirf OD letter ke liye chahiye.
register.choicesIntro: Jin sessions mein seat chahiye woh chuno. Baad mein badal sakte ho.
register.choicesNone: Is event mein chunne ke liye koi session nahi hai.
register.accessibilityHint: Optional. Jo bhi tumhe participate karne mein madad kare: seating, ramp, sign language, khana.
register.adult: Meri umar 18 ya usse zyaada hai
register.guardian: Meri umar 18 se kam hai aur mere parent ya guardian ne is registration ki permission di hai
register.ageError: Aage badhne ke liye inmein se ek confirm karo.
register.consentTitle: Hum tumhari details kaise use karte hain
register.consentPurposes: Tumhari details is event ko chalane ke liye use hoti hain: ticket aur check-in, session seats, khana, tumhare chune sessions ke reminders aur changes, helpdesk ke jawaab, aur maangne par certificate ya OD letter.
register.consentRetention: Event ke 90 din baad hum tumhari personal details delete kar dete hain, jab tak tumne certificate na maanga ho; tab hum sirf wahi rakhte hain jo certificate par dikhta hai.
register.consentSecurity: Tumhara phone aur email encrypted rehta hai. Event assistant sirf ID aur masked details dekhta hai, tumhari contact details kabhi nahi. Hum tumhari details na bechte hain, na share karte hain.
register.consentRights: Apne attendee portal se tum kabhi bhi apna data dekh, download ya delete kar sakte ho.
register.consentAgree: Maine padh liya ki meri details kaise use hongi, aur main agree karta/karti hoon
register.consentError: Aage badhne ke liye agree karo.
register.botCheck: Chhota check ki tum insaan ho
register.resendIn: {seconds} sec mein naya code maang sakte ho
register.errorGeneric: Kuch gadbad ho gayi. Tumhare jawaab safe hain; phir se try karo.
register.errorRateLimited: Bahut zyaada tries. {seconds} sec ruk kar phir try karo.
register.doneWaitlist: Waitlist mein tumhara number {position} hai. Seat khaali hone par hum email karenge.
register.doneDuplicate: Humein milta-julta ek aur registration mila. Team check karke unhe merge kar sakti hai.
register.ticketHint: Ise registration desk par dikhao. Yeh tumhare portal mein bina internet ke bhi khulta hai.
register.invalidPhone: 10 se 12 digit ka phone number daalo

verify.title: Certificate check
verify.intro: Koi bhi yahan certificate check kar sakta hai. Hum sirf wahi dikhate hain jo certificate par likha hai.
verify.validBody: Yeh certificate organisers ne issue kiya hai aur revoke nahi hua hai.
verify.revokedBody: Organisers ne yeh certificate {date} ko revoke kar diya. Yeh ab valid nahi hai.
verify.notFoundBody: Is ID ka koi certificate nahi mila. Link check karo, ya certificate ke neeche chhapi ID dekho.

speakerForm.title: {event} ke liye speaker details
speakerForm.intro: Batao ki tumhare session ke liye kya chahiye. Lagbhag teen minute lagenge, aur update ke liye phir se bhej sakte ho.
speakerForm.avHint: Room mein jo bhi chahiye, sab chuno.
speakerForm.travelHint: Optional. Aane aur jaane ka time, aur kya pickup chahiye.
speakerForm.stayHint: Optional. Agar rehne ki jagah chahiye toh dates.
speakerForm.materialsHint: Optional. Slides ka link, ya jo attendees ko pehle install karna ho.
speakerForm.bioHint: Public event page par dikhega. Teen-chaar lines kaafi hain.
speakerForm.bioConfirm: Mera bio sahi hai aur public mein dikhaya ja sakta hai
speakerForm.bioError: Aage badhne ke liye apna bio confirm karo.
speakerForm.sent: Thank you, tumhari details program team tak pahunch gayi
speakerForm.sentBody: Kuch bhi badalne ke liye yeh link phir se khol sakte ho.
speakerForm.error: Tumhari details nahi bhej paye. Kuch nahi khoya; phir se try karo.
speakerForm.badLink: Yeh link expire ho gaya hai ya valid nahi hai. Program team se naya link maango.

chat.title: Helpdesk
chat.honest: Yeh assistant sirf event ke apne documents se jawaab deta hai aur dikhata hai ki har jawaab kahan se aaya. Jab pakka na ho, toh tumhara sawaal kisi insaan tak pahunchata hai.

chat.escalated: Mujhe pakka nahi pata, isliye maine yeh team ko bhej diya. Woh yahan aur email par reply karenge.
chat.blockedHint: Main event ki har cheez mein madad kar sakta hoon: schedule, venue, khana, rules ya tumhara ticket.
chat.error: Helpdesk tak nahi pahunch paye. Connection check karo aur phir try karo.
chat.demo: Jab tak live helpdesk connect nahi hota, demo jawaab dikh rahe hain.
